part.text:
Good, `dist/` is gitignored so that's fine. Everything is in order — all files written, dependencies added, build and tests pass, and I verified the dev server end-to-end manually.

Summary of changes:
- `src/serve.ts` (new): `serve()` builds the site, serves `./dist` over HTTP, injects a live-reload `<script>` into HTML responses, watches `content/` and `templates/` with chokidar, and broadcasts a `reload` WebSocket message after each debounced rebuild.
- `src/cli.ts`: added `serve` command with `--content`, `--output`, `--templates`, `--port` (default 3000), wired to `serve()`.
- `src/index.ts`: exported `serve`/`ServeOptions`/`ServeHandle` for library use.
- `package.json`: added `chokidar@3` (v5 is ESM-only, incompatible with this CJS project) and `ws` (+`@types/ws`).
- `tests/serve.test.ts` (new): covers page serving, live-reload injection, 404s, and rebuild+WebSocket-reload on both content and template changes.
- `tests/cli.test.ts`: added a test asserting the `serve` command is registered with the right options.
- Manually smoke-tested the built CLI (`ssg serve`) end-to-end: confirmed script injection, initial page content, and rebuild-on-file-change.
